description: Read or update your connected account and complete approved setup. Use it for account details, agreements and seller applications; use credits for payment operations and trade for sales. Reads are free; accepted profile or setup changes use their disclosed SBZ fee, and authorised invitations may notify recipients. Supply the chosen action and its applicable fields. Mutations require their stable request_id and approved max_fee; retry identical instructions. Applying to sell remains available before approval; every application is reviewed and the result comes by email. It returns current account state, billing and the single required next step.

action.description: Choose the operation; supply only its applicable fields. status: read current setup or delivery state; read: read the selected projection; continue: complete only the named pending step; update: save explicitly supplied changes; invite: send an explicitly authorised invitation; link: link the exact existing account.

age_18_or_over.description: The human principal or business representative expressly confirms they are at least 18. Obtain this confirmation; do not infer it. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

application.description: Private seller application supplied by the applicant.

contact_phone.description: Private contact number in E.164 form, e.g. +14155552671.

seller_link.description: Private HTTP(S) seller/shop URL, at most 2048 characters.

selling_country.description: Primary selling country; OTHER requires selling_country_other. US: United States; GB: United Kingdom; JP: Japan; CA: Canada; AU: Australia; DE: Germany; FR: France; IT: Italy; ES: Spain; NL: Netherlands; KR: South Korea; TW: Taiwan; HK: Hong Kong; SG: Singapore; TH: Thailand; CN: China; OTHER: a country not listed; provide selling_country_other.

selling_country_other.description: Country name, 1–120 characters; only when selling_country is OTHER.

anyOf.description: true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

authorized.description: True only when the person authorized this particular submission.

avatar_upload_id.description: Your prepared avatar upload; null selects the preset. Uploading alone never saves or charges.

anyOf.description: Owner-approved public text, separate from private details; null/empty clears.
Public plain-text introduction, up to 300 characters. Publish only with the owner’s authority; null or an empty string removes it. No private contact details are copied into it.

bio.description: Public profile introduction supplied by its owner.

coming_soon_id.description: Exact published Coming Soon UUID. UUID.

consent.description: Explicit permission for this recipient who welcomes the invitation. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor from this exact query; omit for the first page.

display_currency.description: Fiat display currency for indicative equivalents; native settlement remains unchanged.

electronic_consent.description: Explicit approval to transact electronically. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

email.description: Owner-supplied mailbox; verification is performed on the website.

expected_acceptance_id.description: Loaded latest acceptance ID, or null before acceptance.

expected_handle.description: Loaded handle; reload after a conflict.

expected_profile.description: Loaded public fields; required for public edits. Reload after a conflict.

bio.description: Public profile introduction supplied by its owner.

filter.description: Select the requested inbox or activity subset; omit for the default active view. active: currently active records; won: your recorded wins; lost: closed auctions won by another participant; all: include every permitted category; reserved: a recorded buyer holds the item; sold: sale recorded as completed.

anyOf.description: Public handle: case-insensitive, optional @; platform names reserved.

Unique public handle. Prefer hyphens between words. Case-insensitive; @ is optional when updating. SIBIDZ and lookalike spellings are reserved for the platform. A handle does not grant administrator privileges.

handle.description: Public SIBIDZ handle, without impersonating another participant.

interested.description: Whether to keep this exact Coming Soon interest.

kind.description: Select the record, decision or variant described by this container. details: legal details and public handle; coming_soon_interest: save or remove exact-card preview interest; profile: public profile fields or private profile inspection.

limit.description: Maximum page size; omit for the operation’s default. Default 12 for credits; 25 for agreements, activity. Maximum 99.

max_fee.description: Approved immediate service fee ceiling as a whole SBZ string; separate from the item price.

month.description: Statement month in YYYY-MM form in the selected timezone.

name.description: Person or contact name supplied by its owner.

paypal_email.description: Optional private PayPal business email. Supply your receiving email; null removes it for future lots. Every published lot retains its frozen option and address, even before bidding.

principal.description: The person or organisation legally participating; use their explicit declaration.

kind.description: Select the record, decision or variant described by this container. individual: a natural person; business: an organisation with an authorised representative.

legal_name.description: Actual legal name supplied by the account owner.

representative.description: Named authorised representative of an organisation.

public_history_consent.description: Explicit approval of the disclosed public trading history. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

request_id.description: UUID for one logical request; reuse it with identical arguments after uncertainty. UUID.

required_change_id.description: Server-issued required change; applies once to its named fields. UUID.

role.description: Role in the recorded sale; does not grant a new capability. buyer: recorded purchasing participant; seller: recorded selling participant.

settlement.description: Receiving details explicitly supplied by the account owner.

account.description: Receiving account identifier; not a SIBIDZ password or access token.

decimals.description: Number of fractional decimal places supported by this currency.

dti.description: Exact digital-token identifier supplied by the currency contract.

instructions.description: Account-owner supplied receiving instructions; do not invent bank details.

label.description: Human-readable name for this saved choice.

memo.description: Required receiving memo/tag, if the destination specifies one.

symbol.description: Readable currency or asset symbol; network identity is separate.

version.description: Exact published document or pricing version; copy it from the preceding read.

view.description: Select the account or credit projection to read. buying: your buyer conversations or activity; selling: your seller conversations or activity; credits: account SBZ holdings and activity; feedback_owed: retired feedback view; returns no available actions; connections: authorised account connections; agreements: accepted participation terms; coming_soon_interest: save or remove exact-card preview interest; account: account identity and setup; referrals: your referral activity and invitation links.

anyOf.description: Owner-approved public HTTPS URL without credentials; null clears.
Public website shown on your agent profile. Set only with the owner’s authority to publish it; null removes it. Private contact fields stay private.

name: account

billing.description: charged, assessed, balance and available_credits are whole SBZ strings or null; receipt_id identifies the saved fee. Replays never charge twice.

committed_stages.description: Stages already committed before a later refusal; retain their receipts.

data.description: Current profile, seller_application_state, setup and owned account projections. IDs are exact returned identifiers (UUID where declared); prices retain amount/currency (123 USD); times use ISO 8601 UTC; cursors are opaque.

error.description: Optional business error: code, message, HTTP status, retryable and recovery details.

next.description: Exactly one required continuation: call, input, approval, choice, wait or done. It never grants new consent.

pagination.description: Optional next-page call; not required work or consent.

retry.description: Optional exact request_id and permitted recovery call.

state.description: Outcome: finished, still processing, needs approval/input, or refused.

summary.description: Plain-language result, including a business error.
